chapter_notes.title: Canadian Period
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: tips never work, emotional attachment destroys returns. Evidence: BRILUND windfall, KAYRAND commission trap, EASTERN MALARTIC expert failure, $3000 loss after 7 months, advisory service manipulation mechanism. Caveats: CALDER BOUSQUET accidental lesson. All present.

chapter_notes.title: Entering Wall Street
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: overtrading destroys returns, quick profit-taking kills winners. Evidence: $1.89 net profit vs $236 broker commissions, KAISER circular loss, RAYONIER jump-in/out vs hold comparison, OTC illiquidity, insider-following failure. Seven emerging rules. VIRGINIAN RAILWAY forgotten-stock lesson. All present.

chapter_notes.title: My First Crisis
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: fundamentals dont predict price behavior. Evidence: JONES & LAUGHLIN comparison table, all-in disaster ($9069 loss), TEXAS GULF PRODUCING rescue on pure price action. Mechanism: fundamental perfection on paper vs market reality. All present with emotional impact preserved.

chapter_notes.title: Developing the Box Theory
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: stocks move in boxes, buy breakouts, sell breakdowns. Evidence: M&M WOOD WORKING merger profit on price alone, tempestuous beauty analogy, PITTSBURGH METALLURGICAL timing lesson, LOUISIANA LAND on-stop discovery, three successful trades, NORTH AMERICAN AVIATION pride-kills lesson. System crystallization (4 objectives + 4 weapons). All present.

chapter_notes.title: Cables Round the World
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: distance from Wall Street is an advantage, paper trading is useless. Evidence: telegram system mechanics, poker analogy, DJIA discovery, cause-of-error tables, stocks-as-characters insight, 1957 bear market stop-loss vindication table, $889 net loss after the bull market. All present.

chapter_notes.title: Baby-Bear Market
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: bear markets are hospitals, stocks follow earnings, look for future industries. Evidence: summer camp/hospital analogy, Shaw anecdote, stocks-as-slaves-of-earnings discovery, fashion analogy, higher-priced-stocks efficiency, Rothschild parallel, five sleeping stocks identified. Five-year synthesis quote now included. All present.

chapter_notes.title: Theory Starts to Work
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: techno-fundamentalist method works. Evidence: LORILLARD full trade with stop-out/re-entry, cancer scare test, advisory service wrong on short call. DINERS CLUB trade with American Express insider-selling confirmation. E.L. BRUCE spectacular ($295K) with Edward Gilbert takeover, $100 sell-or-hold decision. All present with specific dollar amounts.

chapter_notes.title: My First Half-Million
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: caution after success, dont return to old winners. Evidence: LORILLARD pet-stock losses ($6472 total), P&L summary showing $7759 total losses vs $326K profits. UNIVERSAL PRODUCTS pilot-buy technique. THIOKOL rights play mechanics. $250K cable in Paris. Remember BRUCE card. All present.

chapter_notes.title: My Second Crisis
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: proximity to Wall Street destroys discipline, ears are the enemy. Evidence: $100K loss across 14 named trades, boardroom description, vicious buy-top/sell-bottom cycle, egotism diagnosis, Paris recovery, permanent isolation rules. Most important chapter - fully covered with emotional weight.

chapter_notes.title: Two Million Dollars
chapter_notes.notes: Claims: rigid system adherence required, let market pick winners. Evidence: iron fence rules, 6-broker spread, 7PM routine, UNIVERSAL CONTROLS exit at $86-89 ($409K profit), TEXAS INSTRUMENTS $541K position, THIOKOL climax/NYSE stop-order suspension ($862K profit), four-stock selection method, final positions in ZENITH/FAIRCHILD, $2.25M total, working while Wall Street sleeps. All present.
